# Syddansk Universitetshospital

Syddansk Universitetshospital is a Danish university hospital named in the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) annual reports, a national quality-development database for atrial fibrillation treatment run under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1][^src2]. The hospital is identified as the affiliated institution for [[axel-brandes|Axel Brandes]], a member of the AFDK steering committee, who works at Esbjerg og Grindsted sygehus, part of Syddansk Universitetshospital [^src1].

The mention appears in the governance section of the AFDK 2023 annual report, which covers the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023 and lays out chapters 5–7 describing the database's data foundation — including patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the composition of the steering committee — alongside epidemiological data on atrial fibrillation incidence across Denmark's five regions [^src1]. Syddansk Universitetshospital also appears in the corresponding section of the AFDK 2024 annual report, which covers 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024 and, for the first time, incorporates data from practicing cardiologists who began reporting to the database on 1 June 2023; that report covers 22,073 incident patients and 136,420 prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation [^src2]. In both reports, the hospital's role is limited to identifying the institutional home of a steering-committee member rather than being a subject of independent clinical or organizational claims.
